Adding biometric login to a demo takes an afternoon. Shipping it to thousands of users — with token storage, fallbacks and device quirks — is another story.

The core principle: biometrics never replace your auth system, they unlock a locally stored credential. We keep a refresh token in the device keychain/keystore, gated by the biometric prompt, and treat every failure path — new fingerprint enrolled, hardware unavailable, user cancellation — as a first-class flow back to password login.

The result was a login flow that feels instant and a measurable drop in password resets. The full write-up with implementation details is coming soon.
